flows.name: Discover Tidyboards on landing page
flows.goal: Understand what Tidyboards does and start using it.

steps.userAction: The visitor opens the landing page.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows what tidy personal dashboards are for, how creating a dashboard and adding note, counter, checklist and link-list widgets works, with examples, and offers paths to sign up and sign in.

steps.userAction: The visitor chooses to get started.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the sign-up form to create an account.

flows.outcome: Visitor understands dashboards and starts sign-up; nothing is stored and a refresh shows the same landing page.

flows.name: Sign up as member
flows.goal: Create an account to own dashboards.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to sign up.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty sign-up form asking for email and password.

steps.userAction: The member fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the account, signs the member in, and shows the member's dashboard list.

alternatives.condition: The email is badly formed or the password is shorter than required.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The member has no dashboards yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard.

flows.outcome: Account exists and member is signed in; a refresh still shows the signed-in dashboard list.

flows.name: Sign in as member
flows.goal: Sign in to access my dashboards.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to sign in.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows an empty sign-in form asking for email and password.

steps.userAction: The member fills in email and password and submits.
steps.websiteResponse: The website verifies the credentials and shows the member's own dashboard list with names and last-edited times.

alternatives.condition: The email or password is empty or badly formed.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.

alternatives.condition: Signing in fails for a system reason.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The email is unknown or the password does not match.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the credentials do not match, keeps the typed email, and offers to try again.

alternatives.condition: The member has no dashboards yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard.

flows.outcome: Member is signed in and sees own dashboards; a refresh still shows the signed-in list.

flows.name: Sign out
flows.goal: Leave the account safely on this device.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to sign out.
steps.websiteResponse: The website ends the session and shows the public landing page, hiding all private dashboards.

flows.outcome: Member is signed out; a refresh shows the landing page and no dashboards.

flows.name: Create a dashboard
flows.goal: Start a new dashboard to fill with widgets.

steps.userAction: The member opens the dashboard list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the member's own dashboards with name and last-edited time ordered most-recently-edited first.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to create a dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates a dashboard named Untitled dashboard, sets its last-edited time, and opens it in the editor ready for widgets.

alternatives.condition: The member has no dashboards yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard.
The website keeps the list as it was and offers to retry creating.

flows.outcome: New Untitled dashboard exists and is open in the editor; a refresh still shows it in the list and editor.

flows.name: View dashboard list

steps.userAction: The member opens the dashboard list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows all of the member's own dashboards with name and last-edited time ordered most-recently-edited first, with a way to open any dashboard.

alternatives.condition: The member has no dashboards yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard.

flows.outcome: Member's own dashboards with last-edited times are visible; a refresh shows the same list.

flows.name: Open dashboard in editor
flows.goal: Open a dashboard to view and change it.

steps.userAction: The member opens the dashboard list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the member's dashboards with names and last-edited times.

steps.userAction: The member selects a dashboard from the list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website opens that dashboard in the editor showing its title and all its widgets with their content, ready to view and change with autosave.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard.

alternatives.condition: The chosen dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard is gone and shows the dashboard list.

alternatives.condition: The dashboard has no widgets yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the dashboard title with no widgets and invites the member to add the first widget.

flows.outcome: Chosen dashboard and its widgets are shown in the editor; a refresh shows the same content.

flows.name: Rename dashboard
flows.goal: Give a dashboard a meaningful name.

steps.userAction: The member opens a dashboard to rename it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the dashboard with its current name ready to rename.

steps.userAction: The member edits the dashboard name and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the new name, updates the last-edited time, and shows the new name in the list and editor.

alternatives.condition: The dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard is gone and shows the dashboard list.
The website marks the name as needing a value and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed name and offers to retry.

flows.outcome: Dashboard name is updated and last-edited is refreshed; a refresh shows the new name.

flows.name: Duplicate dashboard
flows.goal: Copy a dashboard with its widgets to reuse it.

steps.userAction: The member opens the dashboard list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the member's own dashboards with name and last-edited time ordered most-recently-edited first.

steps.userAction: The member chooses Duplicate on a dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates a copy named Copy of {name} with all widgets, settings and content copied, updates its last-edited time, and shows it alongside the original.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard and offers a way to create it.

alternatives.condition: The dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard is gone and shows the updated list.
The website keeps the list as it was and offers to retry duplicating.

flows.outcome: Copy with all widgets exists alongside the original; a refresh shows both dashboards.

flows.name: Delete dashboard
flows.goal: Permanently remove a dashboard I no longer need.

steps.userAction: The member opens the dashboard list.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the member's own dashboards with name and last-edited time ordered most-recently-edited first.

steps.userAction: The member chooses Delete on a dashboard.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website invites the member to create the first dashboard and offers a way to create it.
The website permanently removes the dashboard with all its widgets, items and links and shows the updated list without it.
Nothing is deleted; the website shows the dashboard list unchanged.
The website says the dashboard is gone and shows the updated list.

flows.outcome: Dashboard and its widgets are gone; a refresh still shows the list without it.

flows.name: Add widget to dashboard
flows.goal: Add a note, counter, checklist or link-list widget to a dashboard.
preconditions: A dashboard is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to add a widget.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows a creation form with title and widget type choices for note, counter, checklist and link list.

steps.userAction: The member fills in the title, picks a widget type and confirms.
steps.websiteResponse: The website creates the medium-sized widget with default content, autosaves it, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows it ready to use and configure.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the title field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The member cancels adding a widget.
alternatives.websiteResponse: Nothing is added; the website shows the dashboard as it was.

alternatives.condition: The dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard is gone and shows the dashboard list.

flows.outcome: New widget of the chosen type appears in the dashboard; a refresh shows it with its default content.

flows.name: Arrange and rename widget
flows.goal: Rename, resize and reposition widgets to keep the dashboard tidy.
preconditions: A dashboard with at least one widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member views the widgets in the open dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the dashboard title with its widgets in order, each with title, size and content.

steps.userAction: The member edits a widget title and size and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website autosaves the new title and size, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the updated widget.

steps.userAction: The member moves a widget earlier or later relative to other widgets.
steps.websiteResponse: The website autosaves the new order, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the widgets in the new order.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard has no widgets yet and offers a way to add one.
The website marks the title field and keeps what was typed and the chosen size.

alternatives.condition: Saving the title or size fails.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website keeps the typed title and chosen size and offers to retry.
The website keeps the previous order and offers to retry moving.

alternatives.condition: The widget or dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the widget is gone and shows the dashboard as it is now.

flows.outcome: Widget title, size and order are updated and autosaved; a refresh shows the same arrangement.

flows.name: Remove widget
flows.goal: Remove a widget I no longer need.
preconditions: A dashboard with at least one widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member views the widgets in the open dashboard.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the dashboard with its widgets in order, each with title and content.

steps.userAction: The member chooses Remove on a widget.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the dashboard has no widgets yet and offers a way to add one.
The website permanently removes the widget with its content, autosaves the dashboard, updates last-edited, and shows the dashboard without it.
Nothing is removed; the website shows the dashboard unchanged.
The website says the widget is gone and shows the dashboard as it is now.

flows.outcome: Widget and its content are gone; a refresh still shows the dashboard without it.

flows.name: Use note widget
flows.goal: Capture plain text in a note widget.
preconditions: A dashboard with a note widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member edits the plain text inside a note widget.
steps.websiteResponse: The website autosaves the text, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the updated note.

alternatives.condition: The text is longer than 5000 characters.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the text as too long and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed text and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The note widget or dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the widget is gone and shows the dashboard as it is now.

flows.outcome: Note text is saved automatically; a refresh shows the same text.

flows.name: Use counter widget
flows.goal: Track a number with a label using a counter.
preconditions: A dashboard with a counter widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member sets the counter label and saves.
steps.websiteResponse: The website autosaves the label, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the updated label.

steps.userAction: The member presses plus or minus on the counter.
steps.websiteResponse: The website changes the value by 1, autosaves it, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the current count.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks the label field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed label and offers to retry.
The website keeps the previous count and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The counter widget or dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the widget is gone and shows the dashboard as it is now.

flows.outcome: Counter label and value are saved; a refresh shows the same label and number.

flows.name: Use checklist widget
flows.goal: Track tickable tasks in a checklist.
preconditions: A dashboard with a checklist widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member views the checklist widget.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the checklist items with their ticked or unticked states.

steps.userAction: The member adds an item with text to the checklist.
steps.websiteResponse: The website autosaves the new item as unticked, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows it with the other items.

steps.userAction: The member ticks or unticks a checklist item.
steps.websiteResponse: The website toggles the state, autosaves it, updates the dashboard last-edited time, and shows the updated states.

steps.userAction: The member chooses Remove on a checklist item.

alternatives.condition: The checklist has no items yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says there are no items yet and invites the member to add one.
The website marks the item text field and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed text and offers to retry.
The website keeps the previous ticked state and offers to retry.
The website permanently removes the item, autosaves the checklist, updates last-edited, and shows the updated list.
Nothing is removed; the website shows the checklist unchanged.

alternatives.condition: The checklist widget or dashboard was deleted in the meantime.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website says the widget is gone and shows the dashboard as it is now.

flows.outcome: Checklist items and tick states are saved; a refresh shows the same items and states.

flows.name: Use link-list widget
flows.goal: Keep titles and web addresses handy and open them.
preconditions: A dashboard with a link-list widget is open in the editor.

steps.userAction: The member views the link-list widget.
steps.websiteResponse: The website shows the widget title and all saved link titles with their addresses, with options to add a link, edit or remove an entry, and open a link.

steps.userAction: The member adds a link title and address and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the entry automatically, shows it in the link list, and updates the dashboard last-edited time.

steps.userAction: The member edits a link title or address and saves it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website saves the changes automatically, shows the updated entry, and updates the dashboard last-edited time.

steps.userAction: The member selects a link entry to open it.
steps.websiteResponse: The website opens the web address in a new tab and keeps the dashboard unchanged.

steps.userAction: The member chooses to remove a link entry.

alternatives.condition: The link list has no entries yet.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website shows the widget with no entries and invites the member to add the first link.

alternatives.condition: The title is empty or the address does not start with http:// or https://.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.

alternatives.condition: The title is empty or the address does not start with http:// or https://.
alternatives.websiteResponse: The website marks what is wrong and keeps what was typed.
The website keeps the typed values and offers to retry.
The website shows the link list without the entry and updates the dashboard last-edited time.
Nothing is removed; the website shows the link list unchanged.

flows.outcome: Link entries are saved and selecting one opens it in a new tab; a refresh shows the same entries.

fields.label: Email
fields.meaning: Member account address used to sign in and own dashboards

fields.label: Password
fields.meaning: Secret that proves ownership of the member account

fields.label: Dashboard name
fields.meaning: How the member refers to the dashboard in the list and editor

fields.label: Widget title
fields.meaning: How the member refers to the widget inside its dashboard

fields.label: Widget type
fields.meaning: What kind of content the widget holds and how it can be used

fields.label: Widget size
fields.meaning: How much space the widget takes relative to other widgets

fields.label: Note text
fields.meaning: Plain text kept inside a note widget

fields.label: Checklist item text
fields.meaning: One task row inside a checklist widget

fields.label: Link title
fields.meaning: How the member refers to a saved web address

fields.label: Link address
fields.meaning: Web address opened when the link entry is selected

steps.websiteResponse: The website asks to confirm the deletion and says what else will be removed with it.

alternatives.websiteResponse: The website deletes the record and what belongs to it.
Nothing is deleted; the record stays as it was.

assumptions.text: New widgets start titled by type (e.g. 'New note') at medium size with default content: empty note text, counter label empty and value 0, empty checklist and link list.
Dashboard list is ordered most-recently-edited first; an empty list invites creating the first dashboard instead of showing a dead end.
Removing a widget permanently removes its items and links, and removing a checklist item or link entry permanently removes that row, with no trash or undo.
